items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: He’d sit in the back. Oscar was in the front. And Norman would say at the beginning of the tour, he says, “Prez, who you riding with?”

ctx.x: Oh yeah. He was my, well he wouldn’t ride with no one but me driving the car. He’d sit in the back. Oscar was in the front. And Norman would say at the beginning of the tour, he says, “Prez, who you riding with?” He says, “You know who my bitch is, Lady Flip.” He wouldn’t drive with nobody. And we got along great. I used to fix his horn and all that. But he was wonderful. He never bothered anybody and he just had his own way of doing things. We got along great. Great player. But I knew Lester before Jazz at the…
What’s in the immediate future for you. Any traveling? Travel plans?
